title: Semialgebraically connected smooth intersections of two quadrics in projective five-space over real Puiseux series that are not stably rational
author: Jean-Louis Colliot-Thélène; Alena Pirutka; Federico Scavia
work: Variétés réelles semi-algébriquement connexes non stablement rationnelles
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 13 (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.343
difficulty_reason: A standard decomposition-of-diagonal specialization theorem does not by itself cover the singular special fiber used here. The authors pass to quotients by quadratic-extension norms, prove norm-surjectivity on the singular locus and its inverse image, and transport the nonconstant unramified Brauer obstruction through a generic-point DVR to all finite Puiseux extensions. They then construct a real two-quadrics model with only four nonreal singularities and a smooth deformation, while the complete Nash-triviality argument preserves semi-algebraic connectedness of the real locus.
